dependencies_reviewed: research/collect_recoverability.py:query action and frozen-C1 future labels

checks.decision_input_separation: forward(model, batch) passes DECISION_FIELDS only. Labels are loaded earlier but cannot enter model.forward through this wrapper. Neither natural nor forced select_actions reads GT utility.
checks.unavailable_region_leakage: No cross-region feature aggregation was found in the action head. Candidate scores depend on their own inputs, causal history/memory, and original-region keep descriptors. The search head uses original-region features and causal motion/history only. The forced selector exposes original plus exactly one extra region.
checks.forced_controller: Only region_advantage, region_success_logits and absence_logit are replaced. Existing scores, verification probabilities and checkpoint threshold are preserved; select_actions asserts search activation, requested region, allowed selected region and gated action validity.
checks.action_masks: Real caches satisfy action_valid[...,0] == valid and action_valid[...,1] == valid & (raw_score > .84). The diagnostic's gated_valid reproduces the selector's two-sensor regular-write gate.
checks.oracle_targets: region_label_gain reproduces objective's maximum valid action utility within the extra region minus frozen-C1 regular keep utility. available_oracle_net_gain separately maximizes over original plus that extra region. gated_oracle_net_gain additionally enforces selector gate availability.
checks.search_cost: The existing score-space cost remains part of the unchanged selection rule. GT action_utility itself contains no search cost, so subtracting .01 once after utility lookup correctly measures a forced search even when the selector keeps an original-region candidate.
checks.empty_regions: Empty extra regions receive the objective's reference substitution and are excluded from region-pair aggregates. Original-region actions keep union oracle computations finite.
checks.denominators: Region aggregates count nonempty query-region pairs. Missing-target pairs require no correct original-region candidate and at least one correct extra-region candidate. Separate unique-query denominators were added and agree with the existing records. Neither type is a full-video recovery count. Beneficial and harm comparisons now preserve float32 tensor threshold semantics.
checks.training_state: No optimizer, backward pass, checkpoint write, visual extractor forward or live-job change exists in the diagnostic. Model state is loaded strictly and inference uses eval plus no_grad. CPU neural execution was not performed by the reviewer.

nonblocking_reporting_notes.finding: Every reported gain uses frozen-C1 regular keep as its reference. It is not the marginal value of extra search relative to this model's no-search action.
nonblocking_reporting_notes.minimal_change: Keep that reference explicit when interpreting the oracle/selector gap; no new computation is required for the stated training-target diagnostic.
